- Temperature excursions in cold-chain logistics fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data (Ironbark blog).
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage (Ironbark blog).
- Companion piece: cold-chain pilots cut claims by a quarter (Ironbark insights).

Sources: https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain and https://insights.ironbark.example/cold-chain/companion
args.title: Cold-chain logistics 2026 — Ironbark summary
